messages.author: 7aa220d6e661206f
messages.subject: Not able to install RHIPE
parts:
Hi,

I am not yet successful in installing RHIPE and will be grateful for
your kind help.

Environment:
-------------------
OS: Ubuntu 11.10
Hadoop: 0.20.2
Prtobuf: protobuf-2.4.1
Rhipe: 0.66

Status:
-----------
1. installed Hadoop
2. installed protobuf
3. configured PKG_CONFIG_PATH
4. installed r-base, r-base-core, r-base-core-dbg, r-base-dev, r-base-
html,
5. Running R CMD INSTALL Rhipe_0.66.tar.gz

Excerpt of the errors:
----------------------------
1. /usr/local/Rhipe/src/rexp.pb.cc:1318: undefined reference to
'google::protobuf::internal::WireFormat::ComputeUnknownFieldsSize(google::protobuf::UnknownFieldSet
const&)'
2. /usr/local/include/google/protobuf/io/coded_stream.h:980: undefined
reference to
`google::protobuf::io::CodedOutputStream::VarintSize32Fallback(unsigned
int)'
3. /usr/local/Rhipe/src/message.cc:10: undefined reference to
`R_NilValue'
/usr/local/Rhipe/src/message.cc:13: undefined reference to
`Rf_allocVector'
/usr/local/Rhipe/src/message.cc:13: undefined reference to
`Rf_protect'

Thanks and Regards,
Gourav

messages.author: 7aa220d6e661206f
messages.subject: Re: Not able to install RHIPE
parts:
Hi Saptarshi,

Thanks a lot for your kind response and including my query in the
group.

I have installed R using the following commands:
1. Uninstalled all packages of R from Ubuntu using Ubuntu package
manager
2. Downloaded r-base_2.14.0.orig.tar.gz from http://www.stats.bris.ac.uk/R/
and unzip the file to /usr/local/R
3. Ran the following commands:
a. ./configure –enable-R-shlib
b. make
c. make test
d. make install
4. set R_HOME=/usr/local/R
5. ran the command "R CMD INSTALL ./Rhipe_0.66.tar.gz"

Still the same errors are cropping up.

I will be grateful if you could let me know how to proceed with R
installation/ or if there is any guide on the same for manual
installation along with installation of developer library as mentioned
in the thread http://groups.google.com/group/rhipe/msg/ffdf6fe2ac12ca73

Thanks and Regards,
Gourav Sengupta

messages.subject: Re: Not able to install RHIPE
parts:
Hi,

This issue was resolved. There is an additional installation that has to be done after the last update in Ubuntu.

Kindly see the post https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/rhipe/ByoHCsB4Qmc.

After working on the suggestion, the installation worked without any issues.
